Name: COOL_TIME_PARAM_ST
Description: Elden Ring's cooldowns that stop the host's world being visited again by the same kind of multiplayer visitor (invaders, map guardians, hunters); the row is the visitor group and visit count, the column the number of co-op phantoms present. NR still has the reader in its session code, but whether NR's sessions ever use it is not established. Retail: the 40 Elden Ring rows, unchanged.

Fields.Name: Block Time - 0 Co-op Phantoms
Fields.Description: Seconds. After a visit of this row's group, the world can't be visited by that group again until this runs out. Used when no co-op phantoms are present. 0: no block.

Fields.Name: Watch Time - 0 Co-op Phantoms
Fields.Description: Seconds. Starts when the block time ends; another visit of the group before it runs out uses the next row (count + 1), otherwise the count resets to row x01. Used when no co-op phantoms are present.

Fields.Name: Block Time - 1 Co-op Phantom
Fields.Description: Seconds. As Block Time - 0 Co-op Phantoms, used with 1 co-op phantom present.

Fields.Name: Watch Time - 1 Co-op Phantom
Fields.Description: Seconds. As Watch Time - 0 Co-op Phantoms, used with 1 co-op phantom present.

Fields.Name: Block Time - 2 Co-op Phantoms
Fields.Description: Seconds. As Block Time - 0 Co-op Phantoms, used with 2 co-op phantoms present.

Fields.Name: Watch Time - 2 Co-op Phantoms
Fields.Description: Seconds. As Watch Time - 0 Co-op Phantoms, used with 2 co-op phantoms present.

Fields.Name: Block Time - 3 Co-op Phantoms
Fields.Description: Seconds. As Block Time - 0 Co-op Phantoms, used with 3 or more co-op phantoms present.

Fields.Name: Watch Time - 3 Co-op Phantoms
Fields.Description: Seconds. As Watch Time - 0 Co-op Phantoms, used with 3 or more co-op phantoms present.
